value.rationale: The original global phase portrait leaves the natural original-time survival question open near its invariant boundary x=-y. The exact clock resolves it for a full open family, identifies log/loglog/fractional cusp universality regimes and a uniform critical crossover p log K, plus a blow-up exponent discontinuity. These quantities cannot be inferred from orbital topological equivalence and give a useful benchmark for singular escape times in integrable polynomial dynamics, without overclaiming perturbation stability.
